slides.title: What Happened
slides.body: With about 85% of votes counted, Netanyahu's bloc led 53 to 48 seats over Eisenkot's bloc. A majority needs 61 of 120. Counts are provisional.

slides.title: Tel Aviv Stocks, Oct 28
slides.subtitle: % decline at the close
slides.body: The shekel also fell 1.6% to 3.128 per US dollar.

slides.title: Why It Matters
slides.body: Analysts cited coalition talks, living costs and fears of renewed war with Iran. A deadlock could mean weeks of talks, or another vote.

slides.title: What to Watch Next
items: Nov 4: Israel's official election results expected.
Nov 4: US Treasury quarterly refunding announcement.
Nov 6: US October jobs report, 8:30 a.m. ET.
